# Validator schema fixture

`native-lifecycle-packed.jsonl` is copied byte-for-byte from
`docs/verification/packed-pages/prototype-v1/matrix/r0-n1-v0-c0-a4.jsonl`.
It is one retained real native-memory experiment run, with interleaved
`packed_pool` and `memory` records for every stage and one summary. The fixture
proves validator schema handling; reading it is not a fresh native execution or
production allocator qualification. Its original command/identity remains in
the adjacent retained experiment metadata.
